text: diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati . yato kho te mālukyaputta diṭṭhasutamutaviññātabbesu dhammesu diṭṭhe diṭṭhamattaṃ bhavissati sute sutamattaṃ bhavissati mute mutamattaṃ bhavissati viññāte viññātamattaṃ bhavissati tato tvaṃ mālukyaputta na tena yato tvaṃ mālukyaputta na tena tato tvaṃ mālukyaputta na tattha yato tvaṃ mālukyaputta na tattha tato tvaṃ mālukyaputta nevidha na huraṃ na ubhayamantarena esevanto dukkhassāti . imassa khvāhaṃ
